    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    desc = instance.get("descriptors", {}) or {}
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", None)

    cust_set = set(customers)

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for v in route:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

        if not route:
            return 0
        d = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            d += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return d

        for r in routes:
            s += route_dist(r)
        return s

    alpha = 1.0
    if isinstance(desc, dict):

        # Kept small to avoid destabilizing feasibility.
        pressure = desc.get("demand_pressure", None)
        corridor = desc.get("corridor", None)
        if pressure is not None:
            try:
                if pressure > 0.98:
                    alpha = 1.15
                elif pressure < 0.95:
                    alpha = 0.95
            except:
                pass
        if corridor is not None:
            try:
                if corridor < 0.03:
                    alpha *= 1.10
            except:
                pass

    # Initialize one route per customer
    routes = []
    route_of = {}
    for v in customers:
        r = [v]
        routes.append(r)
        route_of[v] = len(routes) - 1

    # Precompute savings list
    # savings i->j: d(depot,i)+d(depot,j)-d(i,j), with tiny deterministic tie-breakers
    savings = []
    n = len(customers)
    # Use list of customers for indexing
    for ii in range(n):
        i = customers[ii]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for jj in range(ii + 1, n):
            j = customers[jj]
            s = (di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]) * alpha
            # Tie-break with demands and ids to keep deterministic
            savings.append((s, demands[i] + demands[j], i, j))

        # 0: reverse a, reverse b, then connect (rare)
        # 1: a as-is, b as-is, connect (a_end + b_start)
        # 2: reverse a, b as-is
        # 3: a as-is, reverse b
        ra = routes[a_idx]
        rb = routes[b_idx]
        if mode == 1:
            left = ra
            right = rb
        elif mode == 2:
            left = list(reversed(ra))
            right = rb
        elif mode == 3:
            left = ra
            right = list(reversed(rb))
        else:
            left = list(reversed(ra))
            right = list(reversed(rb))
        if left is ra and right is rb:
            combined = ra + rb
        else:
            combined = left + right

        la = route_load(ra)
        lb = route_load(rb)
        if la + lb > capacity:
            return False

        routes[a_idx] = combined
        routes[b_idx] = None

            route_of[v] = a_idx
        return True

    # Merge by respecting endpoint connections
    for _, _, i, j in savings:
        ra_idx = route_of.get(i, None)
        rb_idx = route_of.get(j, None)
        if ra_idx is None or rb_idx is None or ra_idx == rb_idx:
            continue
        if routes[ra_idx] is None or routes[rb_idx] is None:
            continue

        ra = routes[ra_idx]
        rb = routes[rb_idx]
        la = route_load(ra)
        lb = route_load(rb)
        if la + lb > capacity:
            continue

        # We allow merging in either direction if endpoints match.
        # Case A end == i and B start == j : ra + rb
        if ra and rb and ra[-1] == i and rb[0] == j:
            if la + lb <= capacity:
                routes[ra_idx] = ra + rb
                routes[rb_idx] = None
                for v in rb:
                    route_of[v] = ra_idx
            continue
        # Case A start == i and B end == j : reverse A then connect
        if ra and rb and ra[0] == i and rb[-1] == j:
            routes[ra_idx] = list(reversed(ra)) + list(reversed(rb))
            routes[rb_idx] = None
            for v in rb:
                route_of[v] = ra_idx
            continue
        # Case A end == i and B end == j : connect ra + reversed(rb)
        if ra and rb and ra[-1] == i and rb[-1] == j:
            routes[ra_idx] = ra + list(reversed(rb))
            routes[rb_idx] = None
            for v in rb:
                route_of[v] = ra_idx
            continue
        # Case A start == i and B start == j : connect reversed(ra) + rb
        if ra and rb and ra[0] == i and rb[0] == j:
            routes[ra_idx] = list(reversed(ra)) + rb
            routes[rb_idx] = None
            for v in rb:
                route_of[v] = ra_idx
            continue

    # Compact routes, rebuild route indices
    new_routes = []
    new_route_of = {}
    for r in routes:
        if r is None:
            continue
        idx = len(new_routes)
        new_routes.append(r)
        for v in r:
            new_route_of[v] = idx
    routes = new_routes
    route_of = new_route_of

    # Deterministic repair/insertion for any missing customers (should be none)
    if len(route_of) != len(cust_set):
        # Any missing customers are appended to best feasible route by increasing distance
        all_seen = set(route_of.keys())
        missing = [c for c in customers if c not in all_seen]
        for v in missing:
            best = None
            best_cost = None
            for idx, r in enumerate(routes):
                if route_load(r) + demands[v] > capacity:
                    continue
                # try insertion at all positions
                for pos in range(len(r) + 1):
                    if pos == 0:
                        cost = matrix[depot][v] + matrix[v][r[0]] - matrix[depot][r[0]]
                    elif pos == len(r):
                        cost = matrix[r[-1]][v] + matrix[v][depot] - matrix[r[-1]][depot]
                    else:
                        a = r[pos - 1]
                        b = r[pos]
                        cost = matrix[a][v] + matrix[v][b] - matrix[a][b]
                    if best_cost is None or cost < best_cost or (cost == best_cost and idx < best):
                        best_cost = cost
                        best = (idx, pos)
            if best is None:
                routes.append([v])
                route_of[v] = len(routes) - 1
            else:
                idx, pos = best
                routes[idx] = routes[idx][:pos] + [v] + routes[idx][pos:]
                route_of[v] = idx

    # Intra-route 2-opt (deterministic first-improvement)
    def two_opt(route):
        m = matrix
        if len(route) < 4:
            return route
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            L = len(route)
            # scan i<k
            for i in range(L - 3):
                a = route[i]
                b = route[i + 1]
                dab = m[a][b]
                for k in range(i + 2, L - 1):
                    c = route[k]
                    d = route[k + 1]
                    # compute delta for reversing segment i+1..k
                    delta = (m[a][c] + m[b][d]) - (dab + m[c][d])
                    if delta < 0:
                        route = route[:i + 1] + list(reversed(route[i + 1:k + 1])) + route[k + 1:]
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return route

    routes = [two_opt(r) for r in routes if r]

    # Inter-route relocate (deterministic best insertion across routes with feasibility)
    def relocate_once(routes):
        best = None
        best_delta = 0
        base_total = total_dist(routes)
        # Precompute loads for speed
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]

        for a_idx in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a_idx]
            if not ra:
                continue
            for bi in range(len(ra)):
                v = ra[bi]
                ra_wo = ra[:bi] + ra[bi + 1:]
                # compute contribution remove delta by recomputing local edges
                # We'll compute total delta by local edge changes at removal position.
                # Determine neighbors in ra
                prev = depot if bi == 0 else ra[bi - 1]
                nxt = depot if bi == len(ra) - 1 else ra[bi + 1]
                remove_cost = matrix[prev][v] + matrix[v][nxt] - matrix[prev][nxt]

                for b_idx in range(len(routes)):
                    if b_idx == a_idx:
                        continue
                    rb = routes[b_idx]
                    if loads[b_idx] + demands[v] > capacity:
                        continue
                    # Try insertion positions (including ends)
                    for pos in range(len(rb) + 1):
                        # insertion breaks edge prev->nxt into prev->v->nxt (or depot edges for ends)
                        if pos == 0:
                            prev2 = depot
                            nxt2 = rb[0]
                            add_cost = matrix[prev2][v] + matrix[v][nxt2] - matrix[prev2][nxt2]
                        elif pos == len(rb):
                            prev2 = rb[-1]
                            nxt2 = depot
                            add_cost = matrix[prev2][v] + matrix[v][nxt2] - matrix[prev2][nxt2]
                        else:
                            prev2 = rb[pos - 1]
                            nxt2 = rb[pos]
                            add_cost = matrix[prev2][v] + matrix[v][nxt2] - matrix[prev2][nxt2]

                        delta = remove_cost + add_cost
                        if delta < best_delta or best is None:
                            # want best improvement: most negative delta
                            if best is None or delta < best_delta:
                                best_delta = delta
                                best = (a_idx, bi, b_idx, pos)

        if best is None:
            return routes
        a_idx, bi, b_idx, pos = best
        v = routes[a_idx][bi]
        # execute move
        ra = routes[a_idx]
        rb = routes[b_idx]
        routes[a_idx] = ra[:bi] + ra[bi + 1:]
        routes[b_idx] = rb[:pos] + [v] + rb[pos:]
        # remove empty
        if not routes[a_idx]:
            routes[a_idx] = None
        # compact if needed
        newr = []
        for r in routes:
            if r is not None:
                newr.append(r)
        return newr
